description: Curses and corruption - damage that arrives slowly and does not stop.

nodes.name: Improved Curse of Agony
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Curse of Agony by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0, built verbatim: 'Increases the damage done by your Curse of Agony by 5%/10%.' The outgoing tree had this as 'Amplify Curse' with a 1-point stub; Amplify Curse is a separate real talent, built below.

nodes.name: Suppression
nodes.description: Increases your chance to hit by 1% per rank and reduces the cost of your curses by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0, built with both halves: 'Increases your chance to hit with spells by 1%/2%/3%, and reduces the mana cost of your Affliction spells.' Kept from the outgoing tree, which had hit_rating alone at 5 ranks. hit_rating is PERCENTAGE POINTS and is NOT a valid STAT_CONVERSION_TARGET.

nodes.name: Improved Corruption
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Corruption by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Increases the damage done by your Corruption by 2%-10%, and increases the critical strike chance of your Corruption.' The damage half is verbatim; the crit half cannot be built because DOTS NEVER ROLL CRIT in this engine. Kept from the outgoing tree, corrected from 6% to the real 2% per rank.

nodes.name: Improved Curse of Weakness
nodes.description: Increases the effect of your Curse of Weakness by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, built verbatim: 'Increases the amount of attack power reduced by your Curse of Weakness by 10%/20%.' ability_<id>_potency scales the ability's own stat_mods, which is the right key for a debuff whose whole content is an attack-power reduction. Note attack_power on a monster is FLAT and is one of only eight stat_mods a MONSTER can read, so this debuff really does land.

nodes.name: Improved Fear
nodes.description: Increases the duration of your Fear by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Causes your Fear spell to inflict a Nightmare on the target when the fear effect ends.' DEPARTURE - there is no trigger on an effect EXPIRING, which is the same gap that blocks Living Bomb for the Mage. Delivered as Fear lasting longer instead. ability_<id>_duration is FLAT turns and POSITIVE EXTENDS.

nodes.name: Fel Concentration
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of your Drain Life and Corruption by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Drain Life, Drain Mana, Drain Soul and Corruption by 70%.' DEPARTURE - no cast times and so no pushback. Being able to keep channelling becomes being able to afford it. Kept from the outgoing tree, which used the FLAT _cost key.

nodes.name: Improved Life Tap
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Life Tap by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, built verbatim: 'Increases the amount of Mana awarded by your Life Tap spell by 10%/20%.' DEPARTURE, and the first draft of this node got it wrong: it authored ability_warlock_life_tap_potency, which is SILENT DEAD DATA because warlock_life_tap is effect_type 'restore_resource' and carries NO stat_mods for _potency to scale. Nothing in the QA chain caught it - audit_talents checks unit conventions and probe --audit-all only checks the ability EXISTS - which is why tools/qa_ability_scoped_fields.py was written. The mana a restore_resource returns is its effect_value and no talent key reaches it, so the node becomes Life Tap's cooldown (a real 3 turns) instead, which delivers more total mana per fight by another route.

nodes.name: Amplify Curse
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Curse of Weakness by 1 turn and the cost of all your curses by 10%.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Reduces the global cooldown of your Curses by 0.5 sec.' There is no global cooldown in this engine. The first draft reduced the cooldown of ALL THREE curses, and TWO OF THE THREE KEYS WERE DEAD: curse_of_agony and curse_of_recklessness both have cooldown 0, so there was nothing to reduce. Only curse_of_weakness has a real cooldown (3 turns). Caught by tools/qa_ability_scoped_fields.py. The node now reduces the one real cooldown AND the cost of all three, which every curse does have, so each rank buys something on every curse. _cost_pct is a FRACTION where POSITIVE IS A REDUCTION. It is Curse of Exhaustion's prerequisite in the real tree; that ability does not exist here.

nodes.name: Soul Siphon
nodes.description: Increases the amount your Drain Life returns by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Increases the amount drained by your Drain Life and Drain Soul spells by an additional 3%/6% for each of your Affliction effects on the target.' DEPARTURE - nothing counts how many of your own effects are on a target, so the per-effect scaling is impossible. Delivered as a flat increase. USES _damage, NOT _healing: the first draft reasoned that Drain Life's return is a heal and so wanted _healing, but warlock_drain_life is effect_type 'spell_damage' in this project - the drain is modelled as damage with a leech, not as a heal - and _healing is read ONLY when school == 'healing' (abilities.py:1584), so it was SILENT DEAD DATA. _damage is read for every ability at abilities.py:1574, before that branch, so it lands. Caught by tools/qa_ability_scoped_fields.py.

nodes.name: Soul Harvest
nodes.description: When you kill an enemy you recover 60 mana per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1 'Improved Drain Soul': 'Returns 7%/14% of your maximum mana if the target is killed by your Drain Soul.' Drain Soul DOES NOT EXIST in this project, but the talent's entire content - mana back when a kill lands - IS buildable, so it is kept and renamed rather than dropped. This is the Mage Arcane lesson applied: dropping a node because its NAMED ability is missing threw away a working proc the first time, when the real text was proc-shaped all along. The outgoing tree had exactly this proc and was right to. grant_resource takes a FLAT amount - there is no pct_max - so the real percentage cannot be expressed and 60 is sized against a level-60 warlock's pool. CHANCE IS 50, NOT 100, because a proc's PAYLOAD does not scale with points and only its CHANCE does - at 100% a 2-rank node would give rank 2 NOTHING, which is what the first draft did until check_talent_balance.py caught it. 50 x 2 = 100, so full rank is the certainty the real talent implies. Warlock resource confirmed MANA before authoring, per the standing check-the-resource rule.

nodes.name: Shadow Embrace
nodes.description: Your Shadow Bolt leaves the target taking 5% more damage for 3 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Your Shadow Bolt and Haunt spells apply the Shadow Embrace effect, increasing all shadow periodic damage dealt to the target by 1%-5%.' Haunt does not exist. Built with the real 5% as a general damage-taken debuff, since there is no shadow-periodic-specific taken key. BARE damage_taken_pct is read RAW on both sides, so 0.05 is 5%, and it is one of only eight stat_mods a MONSTER can read. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Nightfall
nodes.description: Your Corruption and Drain Life have a 2% chance per rank to make your next spells hit harder.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Gives your Corruption and Drain Life spells a 2%/4% chance to cause you to enter a Shadow Trance state after damaging the opponent. The Shadow Trance state reduces the casting time of your next Shadow Bolt spell by 100%.' DEPARTURE - no cast times, so an instant Shadow Bolt is not expressible. The real ability pair, chance and Shadow Trance name are kept, and the payoff becomes damage. NOTE the stat_mod is damage_dealt_pct in PERCENTAGE POINTS: spell_damage would be SILENT DEAD DATA inside a status effect.

nodes.name: Siphon Life
nodes.description: Your Corruption heals you as it burns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, built almost verbatim: 'When you deal damage with your Corruption spell, you are instantly healed for 40% of the damage done.' leech_pct is one of only THREE payloads that read the triggering hit's amount (the others being bonus_pct and smart heals), so this is one of the few talents in the project that genuinely scales off damage dealt - and the real 40% is exact. It is Shadow Mastery's prerequisite, preserved below. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Empowered Corruption
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Corruption by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Increases the damage of your Corruption spell by an amount equal to 12%/24%/36% of your spell power.' Spell-power coefficients are not exposed to talents, so it is direct damage. Stacks with Improved Corruption, as the real pair does. Kept from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Shadow Mastery
nodes.description: Increases your Shadow spell damage by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3, built verbatim: 'Increases the damage dealt or life drained by your Shadow spells by 2%-10%.' USES THE PER-SCHOOL KEY DELIBERATELY. shadow_spell_damage is built as f'{school}_spell_damage' at abilities.py:1371, so a literal grep cannot see it - the family that caused arcane_spell_damage to be WRONGLY declared dead in this project. It is LIVE and correct for a school-scoped talent. The outgoing version granted FLAT shadow_spell_power, which is a different stat. The real talent requires Siphon Life, which connected_to reproduces.

nodes.name: Improved Felhunter
nodes.description: Increases your demon's damage by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3: 'Your Felhunter regains 8%/16% of its maximum mana each time it hits with its Shadow Bite ability.' DEPARTURE - demons have NO RESOURCE in this engine and PETS NEVER FIRE PROCS (there is no fire_proc_trigger in entities/pet.py at all), so neither half is buildable. pet_damage is one of only three pet keys that work, read at pet.py:139. Kept as a concept from the outgoing tree, which was a proc with an empty effects dict.

nodes.name: Malediction
nodes.description: Increases your spell damage by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'Increases your spell damage by 1%/2%/3%, and increases the periodic critical strike chance of your Corruption and Unstable Affliction.' The spell damage is verbatim; the periodic-crit clause CANNOT BE BUILT because DOTS NEVER ROLL CRIT in this engine. The outgoing version was Curse of Agony damage, which is Improved Curse of Agony's job.

nodes.name: Eradication
nodes.description: Your Corruption has a 6% chance to quicken your casting by 20% for 2 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, built almost verbatim: 'When you deal damage with Corruption, you have 6% chance to increase your spell casting speed by 6%-20% for 10 sec.' The real trigger, real ability_filter, real 6% chance and real 20% at full rank. The chance is NOT rank-scaled because the real talent scales its MAGNITUDE, and a proc's payload cannot scale with points - so the payload carries the full value. 10 seconds is 2 turns. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Contagion
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Curse of Agony and Corruption by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, built verbatim for the two that exist: 'Increases the damage of Curse of Agony, Corruption and Seed of Corruption by 1%-5%.' Seed of Corruption does not exist. It is Unstable Affliction's prerequisite, preserved below. Kept from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Dark Pact
nodes.description: Teaches Dark Pact, draining your demon's power into your own.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, kept - the ONLY unlock for warlock_dark_pact, which is requires_talent. Moved from the outgoing tree's tier 6 to its real row.

nodes.name: Death's Embrace
nodes.description: While below half health, your Drain Life returns 10% more per rank and you take 3% less damage per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Increases the amount drained by your Drain Life by 10%/20%/30% while your health is at or below 20%.' DEPARTURE on the condition for the drain half - there is no low-health conditional that scopes to one ABILITY, only the global low_health_* family - so the Drain Life bonus is unconditional and a real low-health mitigation rider is added alongside it. low_health_damage_reduction_pct reads the ACTOR's own health and defaults to a 50% threshold, so low_health_threshold_pct is NOT authored - the outgoing version DID author it at 0.35.

nodes.name: Unstable Affliction
nodes.description: Teaches Unstable Affliction, shadow energy that destroys slowly.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5, kept - the ONLY unlock for warlock_unstable_affliction, which is requires_talent. The real talent requires Contagion, which connected_to reproduces. Moved from tier 3 to its real row.

nodes.name: Everlasting Affliction
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Corruption and Unstable Affliction by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Your Corruption and Unstable Affliction spells gain an additional 1%-5% of your bonus spell damage, and your Drain Life has a chance to refresh Corruption.' Spell-power coefficients are not exposed to talents, so it is direct damage. The refresh clause cannot be built - nothing can refresh another effect's duration from a proc; cast_ability re-casting Corruption was considered and rejected because it would stack with Contagion and Improved Corruption into an unreadable pile on one dot. The outgoing version was Shadow Bolt damage.

nodes.name: Pandemic
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your dots by 10%.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Grants the periodic damage from your Corruption and Unstable Affliction spells the ability to critically hit.' DEPARTURE, AND THE BIGGEST ONE IN THIS TREE: DOTS NEVER ROLL CRIT in this engine - there is no mechanism at all, and status_effects.py applies a dot tick with a bare take_damage call that has no crit roll in it. The talent's entire content is unbuildable, so it becomes flat dot damage, which delivers roughly the same expected value without the variance. dot_damage is a FRACTION. The real talent requires Unstable Affliction, reproduced.

nodes.name: Haunt
nodes.description: Your Shadow Bolt leaves the target taking 10% more damage for 3 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 10, the capstone: 'You send a ghostly soul into the target, dealing Shadow damage and increasing all damage done by your Shadow spells to the target by 20%.' DEPARTURE - there is no warlock_haunt ability to unlock. The debuff half IS buildable and is the half that matters, so it rides Shadow Bolt with icd 2 to keep it a cooldown rather than permanent. 10% rather than 20% because it is now free. It stacks with Shadow Embrace, which is the real interaction.

nodes.name: Withering Agony
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike damage of your spells by 20% per rank.
nodes._source: Authored 6 Nov. Kyle: 'all caster classes should have a 5 point talent that increases their spell crit damage by 100%.' Mirrors priest_shadow's Shadow Power and shaman_elemental's Elemental Fury, both of which are WoW-accurate at 5 x 20%. Placed on tier 4 beside the existing tier-4 block; connected_to is cosmetic (it draws the edge), spending is gated by tier_requirements.
